decision_reason: Host framing codecs pass their current tests, but the specification, conformance corpus, C implementation, RTL cosimulation, physical I3C validation, and production evidence are incomplete.

hardware.role: one I3C controller and one I3C target
pinned Cortex-M0 latency and throughput benchmark only

hardware.model: calibrated oscilloscope or logic analyzer suitable for 12.5 MHz I3C
hardware.role: electrical timing and retained protocol traces

hardware.model: scriptable USB power switch or relay fixture
hardware.role: repeatable cold-boot, brownout, and recovery testing

gates.name: Release plan and machine-readable gate manifest
Reproducible development artifacts and isolated install smoke tests
Specification freeze and framing selection
blockers: The framing bakeoff has not selected one production format.
The draft contains unresolved normative TBD markers, including CCC allocation and EX-1 through EX-6 layouts.

gates.name: Independent normative conformance vectors
blockers: No normative JSON vectors or vector runner exist.

gates.name: Python integration simulator and mixed-bus scenarios
blockers: The simulator and integration-test directories contain only package skeletons.

gates.name: C reference implementation and Python/C differential conformance
blockers: No allocation-free C codec, host sanitizer harness, Cortex-M build, or differential runner exists.

gates.name: Pinned RTL cosimulation
blockers: The cosimulation job is disabled and no cocotb testbench is implemented.
Verilator, Icarus Verilog, and Verible are not installed in the available WSL environment.

gates.name: Physical I3C controller-target and sensor interoperability
blockers: No compatible I3C board, ST-LINK device, bus instrument, or hardware harness is connected.

gates.name: Cortex-M0 performance bakeoff evidence
blockers: The pinned board and Arm GNU 13.3.Rel1 toolchain are unavailable.
The candidate C firmware and ADR-0019/ADR-0020 measurement harnesses do not exist.

gates.name: Robustness, fuzzing, memory-safety, and recovery qualification
blockers: C sanitizer/fuzzer targets and target watchdog, stack-watermark, and malformed-stream campaigns are not implemented.

gates.name: Release supply chain, SBOM, provenance, signing, and rollback artifacts
User, compatibility, support, and known-limitations documentation
